blocks.text: KOTA KINABALU, Sabah – Kampung Numbak villager Adurin Abdul Saris was asleep around midnight on Aug 30 when his brother-in-law, who lived next door, shouted “Fire!” The blaze, which started about 200 houses away, reached his 368 sq ft home, 15km north of Kota Kinabalu, Sabah’s capital, about two hours later. The inferno destroyed more than 200 houses in the water village, where homes are built on stilts over the sea. The cause of the fire remains unknown. Three children died in the blaze.
